subject: Discovery recap & demo — Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps (demo)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency on your customer-facing recommender (90% requests < 300 tokens).
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option for PII, and predictable latency for peak traffic.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in per-token cost while keeping p95 latency under 350ms.

Next step: schedule a technical demo/deep dive with your engineering lead and our solutions engineer so we can walk through latency profiles, model variants, and integration patterns. I’m proposing a 45-minute slot next week — options below (PST):
- Wed 3/3: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Thu 3/4: 11:00–11:45 or 15:00–15:45

If those don’t work, send a few times that do and we’ll align. I’ve attached the discovery notes and our short architecture doc for context.

Attendees suggested from our side: me (AE) + Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer). Please let me know who from Acme should join (engineering lead + security contact recommended).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: acme_discovery_notes.pdf (summary of call / key requirements)

Hi Marissa —

Great summary, thanks. We’d like to move forward with the deep dive. Linda (cc’d) is our engineering lead and will also loop in our security engineer if needed. Of the times you proposed, Thu 3/4 15:00–15:45 PST works best for us.

A couple of asks for the agenda:
1) Please include a bit of time to show expected token/unit cost for our workload (similar traffic to what we discussed).
2) Can you share a Zoom link and calendar invite when scheduled?

Looking forward to it — I’ll block the time on our side once I see the invite.

Best,
Sanjay
Head of Engineering | Acme Analytics
